presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, labels, captions, references and time labels, three terms, all five events in each scene, two shared facts and a neutral note. Standing coordinator rule item 20 (caps with the true reason). The pre-cap values are kept in LAW-0455.presets.precap.json. Each capped field was restored alone to its pre-cap value on top of the shipped preset and rendered (layout verdict, text px, people at the hold): A's response-sent 26 -> 39 and response-received 26 -> 40, B's response-sent 26 -> 39 and response-received 26 -> 40 time labels, the changed fact 65 -> 100, the guide 55 -> 70 and the neutral note 33 -> 70: each one restored makes 1:1 keep its text only by fading both stages out at the hold (0 of 4 people visible at the hold; the standing rule keeps the people at the hold). With every capped field restored: the same (1:1 hold, 0 people). Every capped value stays longer than baseline (the response time labels 26 against 24); every count is kept. Shipped: 16:9 18 px, heads 56.5 px; 9:16 21 px, 64.6 px; 1:1 16.1 px, 50.8 px, 4 people at the hold (rendered).
